name: zfls
description: Fortran language support powered by zfls, a fast native re-implementation of fortls; a replacement for the Modern Fortran extension

virtualWorkspaces.description: zfls reads the project's Fortran files from disk.

zfls.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `zfls` executable. Empty: the one bundled with this extension, or else `zfls` on the `PATH` (for example from `conda install -c conda-forge zfls`).

zfls.signatureHelp.markdownDescription: Show signature help while typing procedure arguments, instead of argument snippets in completions (`--use_signature_help`).

zfls.codeActions.markdownDescription: Offer code actions, such as implementing deferred type-bound procedures (`--enable_code_actions`).

zfls.hoverSignature.markdownDescription: Show the signature of procedures in hover (`--hover_signature`).

zfls.preferImplementation.markdownDescription: Hover and go to definition use the implementation of a procedure declared in an interface, such as a separate module procedure's body in a submodule, instead of the interface (`--prefer_implementation`). Go to Implementation reaches the body either way.

zfls.lowercaseIntrinsics.markdownDescription: Complete intrinsics and keywords in lowercase (`--lowercase_intrinsics`).

zfls.autocompleteNameOnly.markdownDescription: Complete only procedure names, without their arguments (`--autocomplete_name_only`).

zfls.autocompleteNoSnippets.markdownDescription: Do not use snippets with placeholders in completions (`--autocomplete_no_snippets`).

zfls.autocompleteNoAutoUse.markdownDescription: Do not offer the public names of modules that are not used yet; by default completing one adds its `use module, only: name` statement (`--autocomplete_no_auto_use`).

zfls.sortKeywords.markdownDescription: Show variable keywords and procedure definitions sorted (`--sort_keywords`).

zfls.symbolSkipMembers.markdownDescription: Leave type members out of document symbols (`--symbol_skip_mem`).

zfls.diagnosticSeverity.markdownDescription: Severity of zfls's diagnostics by code, `off` to hide them (`--diagnostic_severity`), e.g. `{"masks-parent": "off"}`. The code of a diagnostic shows in the Problems panel. In the code, a comment `! zfls: disable=masks-parent` hides a code on its line (`! zfls: disable` every code), `! zfls: disable-next-line=...` on the next line, and `! zfls: disable-file=...` in the file.

zfls.externalModules.markdownDescription: Modules that are not in the project, such as those of MPI or PETSc, that `USE` statements may name without a "not found" diagnostic (`--external_modules`); glob patterns, case-insensitive, e.g. `["mpi", "petsc*"]`.

zfls.notifyInit.markdownDescription: Show a notification when the workspace has been indexed (`--notify_init`).

zfls.nthreads.markdownDescription: Threads used to index the workspace (`--nthreads`; zfls's default is 4).

zfls.maxLineLength.markdownDescription: Warn about code lines longer than this (`--max_line_length`; -1: off).

zfls.maxCommentLineLength.markdownDescription: Warn about comment lines longer than this (`--max_comment_line_length`; -1: off).

zfls.fixedFormLineLength.markdownDescription: Columns of code in a fixed-form line, as gfortran's `-ffixed-line-length-n` (72, 80 or 132): the rest is highlighted as a comment and is not read for names; `-1` for no limit (`--fixed_line_length`). Shown through semantic highlighting.

zfls.configFile.markdownDescription: Configuration file to read instead of `.fortlsrc`, `.fortls.json` or `.fortls` (`--config`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.

zfls.sourceDirs.markdownDescription: Folders with source files, relative to the workspace folder or absolute; globs allowed (`--source_dirs`; default: the whole workspace folder). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.

zfls.includeDirs.markdownDescription: Folders searched for `#include` and `INCLUDE` files (`--include_dirs`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.

zfls.compileCommands.markdownDescription: The `compile_commands.json` (or the folder that holds it) whose Fortran entries add include folders (`-I`) and preprocessor definitions (`-D`), e.g. `${workspaceFolder}/build-debug` (`--compile_commands`). Empty: one in the workspace folder or its `build` folder, if any. An `fpm.toml` in the workspace folder adds its include folder and preprocessor macros too.

zfls.excludePaths.markdownDescription: Folders not to index (`--excl_paths`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}` and `~` are expanded.

zfls.includeSuffixes.markdownDescription: More file extensions to index as Fortran, e.g. `.inc` (`--incl_suffixes`).

zfls.ppSuffixes.markdownDescription: File extensions to run the preprocessor on (`--pp_suffixes`; default: upper-case extensions such as `.F90`).

zfls.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra command-line options for `zfls`, after those of the settings above; zfls accepts the same options as fortls (run `zfls --help`). Settings in a `.fortlsrc`, `.fortls.json` or `.fortls` file in the workspace also apply.

zfls.disableModernFortranCheck.markdownDescription: Do not recommend disabling the Modern Fortran extension, which zfls replaces, when both are enabled.

zfls.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the messages between VS Code and zfls in the `zfls` output channel.

zfls.run.compiler.markdownDescription: The compiler that builds the file for **Run Fortran File** and **Debug Fortran File**, for example `gfortran`, `ifx`, `flang`, `nvfortran`, `nagfor` or `lfortran`; it is looked up on the `PATH` unless `#zfls.run.compilerPath#` is set.

zfls.run.compilerPath.markdownDescription: The compiler executable, or the directory that holds `#zfls.run.compiler#`, when it is not on the `PATH`. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}`, `${userHome}` and a leading `~` are expanded.

zfls.run.buildArgs.markdownDescription: Compiler arguments, before the source file and the output file, which the extension adds. Not set (`null`): debug information without optimization, `-g -O0` (`/Zi /Od` for `ifx` and `ifort` on Windows, `-g` for `lfortran`). Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.run.compilerPath#`, and `${file}` and `${fileDirname}` too.

zfls.run.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Where the program and the compiler's module and object files go. Empty: a directory per source file in the extension's storage, so nothing is written next to the sources. A relative path is relative to the workspace folder.

zfls.run.cwd.markdownDescription: The working directory of the program; by default the directory of the file.

enumDescriptions: The first installed of C/C++ (cppvsdbg for programs of ifx, ifort and LLVM Flang on Windows, else cppdbg), CodeLLDB and CDT GDB
C/C++ extension (ms-vscode.cpptools) with gdb, or lldb on macOS
C/C++ extension with the Visual Studio debugger (Windows, MSVC-ABI programs)
zfls.run.debugger.markdownDescription: The debugger for **Debug Fortran File**. None is bundled: install one of the extensions it names.

zfls.run.gdbPath.markdownDescription: The `gdb` for the `cppdbg` and `gdb` debuggers. Empty: the `gdb` next to the compiler, else the one on the `PATH`.

enumDescriptions: Indent with findent (free and fixed form)
zfls.formatting.formatter.markdownDescription: The external tool that formats Fortran files and selections (**Format Document**, **Format Selection**, format on save). It must be installed separately: `pip install findent` or `pip install fprettify`. Can be set per language, for example `"[FortranFixedForm]": { "zfls.formatting.formatter": "findent" }`.

zfls.formatting.path.markdownDescription: The formatter executable, or the directory that holds it, when it is not on the `PATH`. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}`, `${userHome}` and a leading `~` are expanded; a relative path is relative to the workspace folder.

zfls.formatting.findentArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for `findent`, one per item, for example `["-i4"]`. The extension passes `-ifree` or `-ifixed` from the file's language unless these set the input format, and `-Ia` (keep the selection's indentation) when formatting a selection. Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.formatting.path#`.

zfls.formatting.fprettifyArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for `fprettify`, one per item, for example `["--indent", "4", "--enable-decl"]`. fprettify also reads `.fprettify.rc` files from the file's directory and its parents. Variables are expanded as in `#zfls.formatting.path#`.

zfls.linter.compiler.markdownDescription: Compiler that checks Fortran files when they are opened and saved; its errors and warnings show in the file and in the Problems panel. `Disabled` turns compiler diagnostics off. If the compiler is not found, zfls says so once and checks nothing.

zfls.linter.compilerPath.markdownDescription: The compiler executable, or the directory that holds it. Empty: `zfls.linter.compiler` looked up on the `PATH`. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved; a relative path is relative to the workspace folder.

zfls.linter.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Further compiler options, such as `-std=f2018` or `-DDEBUG`. When empty, the compiler's usual warnings are on (`-Wall` for gfortran, `-warn all` for Intel, `-Minform=warn` for nvfortran); when set, these replace them. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved.

zfls.linter.includePaths.markdownDescription: Directories searched for `INCLUDE` files and `.mod` files (`-I`). Glob patterns such as `${workspaceFolder}/build/**/include` match directories. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved; relative paths are relative to the workspace folder. Run **zfls: Clear Compiler Diagnostics** after creating directories that a pattern should match.

zfls.linter.modOutput.markdownDescription: Directory for the `.mod` files the compiler writes while checking. Empty: a directory in VS Code's storage for this workspace, never the source tree. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved.

zfls.linter.lintOnSave.markdownDescription: Check a file when it is saved (files are always checked when opened).

zfls.linter.lintOnType.markdownDescription: Check a file while it is edited, `#zfls.linter.lintOnTypeDelay#` milliseconds after the last change, compiling a copy of the unsaved text.

zfls.linter.lintOnTypeDelay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds without changes before `#zfls.linter.lintOnType#` checks a file.

zfls.linter.resolveModules.markdownDescription: Before checking a file, compile the workspace files that define the modules it uses (and the modules those use), if their `.mod` files are missing or older than the files, so that `use` statements find them. Saving a module file checks the open files that use it again.

zfls.linter.fypp.enabled.markdownDescription: Run [fypp](https://fypp.readthedocs.io) on each file before compiling it. Without it, `.fypp` files are not checked.

zfls.linter.fypp.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `fypp` executable. Variables `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${userHome}`, `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}` and a leading `~` are resolved.

zfls.linter.fypp.definitions.markdownDescription: Definitions passed to `fypp` as `-DNAME=VALUE` (`-DNAME` when the value is empty).

zfls.linter.fypp.includes.markdownDescription: Include directories passed to `fypp` (`-I`); glob patterns and variables as in `#zfls.linter.includePaths#`.

zfls.linter.fypp.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Further `fypp` options. zfls passes `--line-numbering --line-marker-format=cpp`, and `--fixed-format` for fixed-form files.
